info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Rideshare Rides Ratings-v2-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Rides Rating API provides access to retrieve ratings for rideshare services within the application. It allows users to view aggregated feedback on rides, helping passengers evaluate service quality and make informed choices. This API is typically used by developers looking to integrate ratings functionality into their apps or platforms, providing insights and transparency for user experiences. Utilize this endpoint to enhance customer engagement and drive improvements in rideshare services.

get.summary: Retrieve the rating for a specific ride.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the overall rating for a particular ride. It returns the average rating based on user feedback and reviews, enabling better decision-making for new riders.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving the rating of rides. It contains the necessary data to evaluate the user's rating preferences and specific ride details.
